title.hi: अमीनो अम्लों में ज़्विटर आयन का निर्माण

description.en: In aqueous solution, the carboxyl group can lose a proton and the amino group can accept a proton, giving rise to a dipolar ion known as a zwitterion. This makes amino acids amphoteric in nature.
description.hi: जलीय विलयन में, कार्बोक्सिल समूह एक प्रोटॉन खो सकता है और अमीनो समूह एक प्रोटॉन स्वीकार कर सकता है, जिससे एक द्विध्रुवीय आयन उत्पन्न होता है जिसे ज़्विटर आयन के रूप में जाना जाता है। यह अमीनो अम्लों को प्रकृति में उभयधर्मी (amphoteric) बनाता है।
description.hinglish: Aqueous solution mein, carboxyl group proton lose karta hai aur amino group proton gain karta hai, jisse ek dipolar ion banta hai jise Zwitterion kehte hain. Is wajah se amino acids amphoteric (acid and base both) hote hain.

svgContent:
<svg viewBox="0 0 600 200" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Normal Amino Acid -->
  <g transform="translate(50, 60)">
    <text x="50" y="-30" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#374151" text-anchor="middle">Neutral form</text>
    
    <!-- Central Carbon -->
    <text x="45" y="20" font-family="Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#111827">CH</text>
    
    <!-- R group down -->
    <line x1="60" y1="30" x2="60" y2="60" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="55" y="80" font-family="Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#10b981">R</text>
    
    <!-- NH2 group left -->
    <line x1="40" y1="15" x2="10" y2="15" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="-25" y="20" font-family="Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#2563eb">H₂N</text>
    
    <!-- COOH group right -->
    <line x1="85" y1="15" x2="115" y2="15" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="120" y="20" font-family="Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#ef4444">COOH</text>

    <!-- Arrow showing proton transfer -->
    <path d="M 160 5 Q 80 -40 5 -5" fill="none" stroke="#8b5cf6" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4,4" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />
    <text x="80" y="-20" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#8b5cf6" text-anchor="middle">H⁺ transfer</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Equilibrium Arrows -->
  <g transform="translate(260, 65)">
    <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="40" y2="0" stroke="#4b5563" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrow-head)" />
    <line x1="40" y1="10" x2="0" y2="10" stroke="#4b5563" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrow-head-rev)" />
  </g>

  <!-- Zwitterion -->
  <g transform="translate(380, 60)">
    <text x="50" y="-30" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#374151" text-anchor="middle">Zwitterion (Dipolar ion)</text>
    
    <!-- Central Carbon -->
    <text x="45" y="20" font-family="Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#111827">CH</text>
    
    <!-- R group down -->
    <line x1="60" y1="30" x2="60" y2="60" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="55" y="80" font-family="Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#10b981">R</text>
    
    <!-- NH3+ group left -->
    <line x1="40" y1="15" x2="10" y2="15" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="-30" y="20" font-family="Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#2563eb">H₃N⁺</text>
    
    <!-- COO- group right -->
    <line x1="85" y1="15" x2="115" y2="15" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="120" y="20" font-family="Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#ef4444">COO⁻</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Arrow markers def -->
  <defs>
    <marker id="arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#8b5cf6" />
    </marker>
    <marker id="arrow-head" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto">
      <path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#4b5563" />
    </marker>
    <marker id="arrow-head-rev" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="1" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M 10 0 L 0 5 L 10 10 z" fill="#4b5563" />
    </marker>
  </defs>
</svg>
